title: {p} & {v} Risotto
steps: Soften an onion with the {spice} in a wide pan, then stir in the {s} for a minute until the edges turn glassy.
Add warm stock or lightly salted water a ladle at a time, stirring often and letting each addition soak in, until creamy and just tender, about 20 minutes.
Cook the {p} in a separate pan until {doneness}, and sauté the {v} until golden.
Fold the {p} and {v} into the {s} and finish with the {sauce}.
tip: Pack in extra veg and finish with a little cheese rather than a lot of butter or cream.
